title: How cats always land on their feet

scenes.text: Cats seem to break the laws of physics.
A falling cat has nothing to push against, yet it flips upright.
The trick: it bends in the middle, turning into two halves.
The front tucks its legs and spins fast, while the back stretches out and barely turns.
Then it swaps: tuck the back, stretch the front.
Total spin stays zero, so no law is broken. It's called the righting reflex.
